purpose: Connect tracked source/build declarations to produced container stages/services using explicit, bounded, deterministic evidence.
dynamic_input_policy: retain unresolved evidence instead of guessing

build_context_policy.compose: authoritative explicit context for supported Compose mapping form
build_context_policy.fallback: Dockerfile parent directory only when no Compose context is found, labeled lower precision

security.supply_chain_use: lineage augments but does not replace SBOM, signature, provenance, or vulnerability evidence

non_claims: does not prove runtime contents match source without a build/provenance attestation
does not infer arbitrary RUN command outputs
does not expand directory selectors into unbounded file-edge fanout
